title: AI Helpy for AI Textbook
summary: Elice describes AI textbooks with tailored feedback, language support, and teacher oversight. Learning gains and teacher time savings are unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Elice describes an AI textbook platform with tailored feedback, language support, and teacher oversight, including a pilot. Learning gains and teacher time savings are unmeasured.
purpose: Provide personalized, age-appropriate feedback within school curricula.

ratings.reason: The deployed textbook system provides immediate personalized feedback in five supported languages. This is a direct assistance benefit, without a measured learning gain.
Teachers are intended to save work while providing tailored feedback. Workload reductions are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use case 3: AI Helpy for AI Textbook

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: AI Helpy personalizes textbook feedback
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
